rules.title: Authorized user provisioning
rules.description: Logical access to systems and data is granted only to authorized users based on documented approval.
rules.requirement: The policy must state that user access is provisioned only after documented authorization or approval tied to a business need or role.

rules.title: Timely access deprovisioning
rules.description: Access is removed promptly when no longer required, such as upon termination or role change.
rules.requirement: The policy must require removal or disabling of user access within a defined timeframe after termination or role change.

rules.title: Least privilege access
rules.description: Users are granted the minimum access necessary to perform their job functions.
rules.requirement: The policy must explicitly require least-privilege or minimum-necessary access assignment.

rules.title: Periodic access reviews
rules.description: User access rights are reviewed on a defined periodic basis and inappropriate access is revoked.
rules.requirement: The policy must require periodic access reviews at a defined cadence (e.g. quarterly, every 90 days, annually) including privileged accounts.

rules.title: Privileged access management
rules.description: Administrative and privileged access is restricted, separately authorized, and monitored.
rules.requirement: The policy must restrict privileged/administrative access to authorized personnel with separate approval and monitoring or logging of privileged activity.

rules.title: Unique user identification
rules.description: Each user is identified and authenticated with unique credentials before access is granted.
rules.requirement: The policy must require unique user accounts/credentials and prohibit or control shared accounts.

rules.title: Multi-factor authentication
rules.description: Multi-factor authentication is required for remote and privileged access to systems.
rules.requirement: The policy must mandate multi-factor authentication for remote access and/or privileged accounts.

rules.title: Password policy requirements
rules.description: Passwords meet defined complexity, length, and rotation requirements and are stored securely.
rules.requirement: The policy must define password complexity/length requirements and secure storage (hashing, no plaintext).

rules.title: Role-based authorization
rules.description: Access to data and functions is authorized based on roles aligned to job responsibilities.
rules.requirement: The policy must define role-based authorization where access rights derive from documented job roles.

rules.title: Network boundary protection
rules.description: System boundaries are protected with firewalls and network segmentation controls.
rules.requirement: The policy must require boundary protection such as firewalls, network segmentation, or DMZ controls for external-facing systems.

rules.title: Encryption of data in transit
rules.description: Sensitive data transmitted over public networks is encrypted using approved protocols.
rules.requirement: The policy must require encryption (e.g. TLS) for sensitive data transmitted over public or untrusted networks.

rules.title: Encryption of data at rest
rules.description: Sensitive data stored on systems and media is encrypted at rest.
rules.requirement: The policy must require encryption at rest for sensitive data stored on servers, databases, endpoints, or removable media.

rules.title: Malware prevention
rules.description: Systems are protected against malicious software with detection and prevention controls.
rules.requirement: The policy must require anti-malware/endpoint protection on systems handling sensitive data, with updates and alerting.

rules.title: Security event logging
rules.description: Security-relevant events are logged with sufficient detail to support investigation.
rules.requirement: The policy must require logging of security events (authentication, privilege use, system changes) with retention requirements.

rules.title: Security monitoring and alerting
rules.description: Systems are monitored for anomalies and alerts are generated for suspected security events.
rules.requirement: The policy must require monitoring of systems/networks for security anomalies with alerting to responsible personnel.

rules.title: Incident identification and reporting
rules.description: Security incidents are identified, reported, and triaged through defined channels.
rules.requirement: The policy must define how security incidents are identified and reported, including employee reporting channels.

rules.title: Incident response procedures
rules.description: Documented incident response procedures define roles, escalation, containment, and recovery steps.
rules.requirement: The policy must define incident response procedures including roles/responsibilities, escalation paths, containment, and recovery.

rules.title: Post-incident review and recovery
rules.description: Incidents are followed by recovery activities and lessons-learned reviews.
rules.requirement: The policy must require post-incident recovery steps and a lessons-learned or postmortem review process.

rules.title: Incident communication
rules.description: Affected parties are notified of security incidents per defined communication procedures.
rules.requirement: The policy must define communication/notification procedures for incidents affecting customers or stakeholders, including timelines.

rules.title: Authorized changes
rules.description: Changes to infrastructure, data, or software are authorized before implementation.
rules.requirement: The policy must require documented approval/authorization of changes before they are implemented in production.

rules.title: Change testing
rules.description: Changes are tested before deployment to production.
rules.requirement: The policy must require testing of changes in a non-production environment before production deployment.

rules.title: Rollback and recovery from changes
rules.description: Changes include documented rollback or remediation plans in case of failure.
rules.requirement: The policy must require rollback or remediation plans for changes that could impact production.

rules.title: Emergency change handling
rules.description: Emergency changes follow an expedited but documented approval path.
rules.requirement: The policy must define an emergency change process with retrospective approval or documentation requirements.

rules.title: Periodic risk assessment
rules.description: The entity performs risk assessments on a defined periodic basis covering threats to objectives.
rules.requirement: The policy must require periodic (defined cadence) risk assessments covering threats to security objectives.

rules.title: Risk treatment and acceptance
rules.description: Identified risks are treated, mitigated, or formally accepted by management.
rules.requirement: The policy must define how identified risks are mitigated, transferred, or formally accepted with ownership.

rules.title: Vendor risk assessment
rules.description: Vendors and third parties are assessed for security risk before engagement and periodically thereafter.
rules.requirement: The policy must require security assessment or due diligence of vendors/third parties before engagement and on a periodic basis.

rules.title: Vendor contractual security requirements
rules.description: Vendor agreements include security, confidentiality, and data protection obligations.
rules.requirement: The policy must require security and confidentiality clauses in contracts with vendors handling sensitive data.

rules.title: Data classification scheme
rules.description: Data is classified by sensitivity and handled according to its classification level.
rules.requirement: The policy must define a data classification scheme with handling requirements per classification level.

rules.title: Data retention and disposal
rules.description: Data is retained per defined schedules and securely disposed of when no longer needed.
rules.requirement: The policy must define data retention periods and secure disposal/destruction procedures.

rules.title: Data backup procedures
rules.description: Data is backed up on a defined schedule and backups are protected and tested.
rules.requirement: The policy must require scheduled backups with defined frequency, protection of backup media, and periodic restoration testing.

rules.title: Capacity and availability planning
rules.description: System capacity is monitored and planned to meet availability commitments.
rules.requirement: The policy must require monitoring of system capacity/performance and planning to meet availability objectives.

rules.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery
rules.description: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans exist, are tested, and define recovery objectives.
rules.requirement: The policy must require documented BC/DR plans with defined recovery objectives (RTO/RPO) and periodic testing.

rules.title: Security awareness training
rules.description: Personnel receive security awareness training at hire and on a recurring basis.
rules.requirement: The policy must require security awareness training for all personnel at onboarding and at least annually thereafter.

rules.title: Personnel background screening
rules.description: Background checks are performed for personnel with access to sensitive systems or data.
rules.requirement: The policy must require background verification/screening for employees or contractors before granting access to sensitive systems.

rules.title: Security policy communication
rules.description: Security policies are documented, approved, and communicated to personnel.
rules.requirement: The policy framework must require documented security policies that are approved by management and communicated to all personnel.

rules.title: Ongoing control monitoring
rules.description: The entity monitors the ongoing effectiveness of internal controls.
rules.requirement: The policy must require ongoing or periodic evaluation of control effectiveness (e.g. internal audits, control testing).

rules.title: Physical access controls
rules.description: Physical access to facilities housing sensitive systems is restricted and logged.
rules.requirement: The policy must restrict physical access to facilities/data centers to authorized individuals with logging or badging.

rules.title: Vulnerability management
rules.description: Systems are scanned for vulnerabilities and remediated within defined timeframes.
rules.requirement: The policy must require periodic vulnerability scanning and remediation within defined SLAs based on severity.

rules.title: Patch management
rules.description: Security patches are applied within defined timeframes based on risk.
rules.requirement: The policy must require timely application of security patches with defined timeframes for critical patches.

rules.title: Asset inventory management
rules.description: An inventory of information assets is maintained with assigned ownership.
rules.requirement: The policy must require maintaining an inventory of information assets with assigned owners.

rules.title: Session and lockout controls
rules.description: Sessions are protected with automatic lockout after inactivity and failed-attempt limits.
rules.requirement: The policy must require automatic session timeout/screen lock after inactivity and account lockout after repeated failed logins.

rules.title: Cryptographic key management
rules.description: Cryptographic keys are generated, stored, rotated, and revoked under defined procedures.
rules.requirement: The policy must define cryptographic key management including secure storage, rotation, and revocation procedures.

rules.title: Acceptable use of assets
rules.description: Acceptable use rules for company assets and systems are defined and acknowledged.
rules.requirement: The policy must define acceptable use of company systems/assets and require personnel acknowledgment.

rules.title: Ongoing vendor monitoring
rules.description: Vendor compliance with security requirements is monitored on an ongoing basis.
rules.requirement: The policy must require ongoing monitoring or periodic reassessment of vendor security posture (e.g. annual reviews, SOC report collection).

rules.title: Control deficiency remediation
rules.description: Identified control deficiencies are evaluated and remediated in a timely manner.
rules.requirement: The policy must require tracking and timely remediation of identified control deficiencies or audit findings.

rules.title: Management and board oversight
rules.description: Management/board provides oversight of the security program with defined responsibilities.
rules.requirement: The policy must define management or board-level oversight responsibilities for the security program.

rules.title: Removable media controls
rules.description: Use of removable media is restricted and encrypted when permitted.
rules.requirement: The policy must restrict or prohibit removable media (USB) usage and require encryption when permitted.

rules.title: Secure configuration baselines
rules.description: Systems are deployed using hardened configuration baselines.
rules.requirement: The policy must require hardened configuration baselines or benchmarks (e.g. CIS) for deployed systems.

rules.title: Processing completeness and accuracy
rules.description: Controls ensure data processing is complete, accurate, and authorized.
rules.requirement: The policy must define controls ensuring processing completeness, accuracy, and authorization (e.g. input validation, reconciliation).

rules.title: Confidential information protection
rules.description: Confidential information is identified and protected throughout its lifecycle.
rules.requirement: The policy must require identification and protection of confidential information throughout its lifecycle including transmission and storage.
